zh: 我昨天去了超市。
en: I {went::go} to the supermarket yesterday.

zh: 他昨天下午帮我把箱子搬上了楼。
en: He {carried::carry} the boxes upstairs for me yesterday afternoon.

zh: 她上周买了一台新笔记本电脑。
en: She {bought::buy} a new laptop last week.

zh: 昨天下午雨停了。
en: The rain {stopped::stop} yesterday afternoon.

zh: 他去年在奥克兰教数学。
en: He {taught::teach} maths in Auckland last year.

zh: 我昨天没去健身房。
en: I {didn't go|did not go::not go} to the gym yesterday.

zh: 我们上个月就计划好了这次旅行。
en: We {planned::plan} this trip last month.

zh: 我今天早上赶上了七点的公交车。
en: I {caught::catch} the seven o'clock bus this morning.

zh: 我昨晚试着重启路由器，但没有用。
en: I {tried::try} restarting the router last night, but it didn't help.

zh: 我们昨晚选了一家泰国餐厅。
en: We {chose::choose} a Thai restaurant last night.

zh: 去年我们在日本各地旅行。
en: We {travelled|traveled::travel} around Japan last year.

zh: 上周末我们开车去了陶波。
en: We {drove::drive} to Taupo last weekend.

zh: 你昨天看到我发的邮件了吗？
en: {Did you see::you, see} the email I sent yesterday?

zh: 昨晚水管冻住了。
en: The pipes {froze::freeze} last night.

zh: 在上周的调查中，大多数人更喜欢旧的设计。
en: Most people {preferred::prefer} the old design in last week's survey.

zh: 我昨天用信用卡付了账。
en: I {paid::pay} the bill by credit card yesterday.

zh: 昨天他们把会议推迟到了下周。
en: Yesterday they {postponed::postpone} the meeting until next week.

zh: 我们上个月在吃的上面花了太多钱。
en: We {spent::spend} too much money on food last month.

zh: 航空公司昨晚取消了我们的航班。
en: The airline {cancelled|canceled::cancel} our flight last night.

zh: 他昨天在我的显示器上贴了一张便条。
en: He {stuck::stick} a note on my monitor yesterday.

zh: 她去年在大学学了会计。
en: She {studied::study} accounting at university last year.

zh: 上周末你们去了哪里？
en: Where {did you go::you, go} last weekend?

zh: 昨天比赛结束后，他把球扔给了我。
en: He {threw::throw} the ball to me after the game yesterday.

zh: 客户昨天几分钟之内就回复了。
en: The client {replied::reply} within minutes yesterday.

zh: 她昨天面试时穿了一件黑色外套。
en: She {wore::wear} a black jacket to the interview yesterday.

zh: 故障发生在上周二凌晨。
en: The outage {occurred::occur} early last Tuesday morning.

zh: 我昨晚给客户写了一封很长的邮件。
en: I {wrote::write} a long email to the client last night.

zh: 我的家庭医生上周把我转给了一位专科医生。
en: My GP {referred::refer} me to a specialist last week.

zh: 去年她带领团队完成了迁移项目。
en: She {led::lead} the team through the migration project last year.

zh: 她昨晚没吃晚饭。
en: She {didn't eat|did not eat::not eat} dinner last night.

zh: 我昨天在停车场把手机摔了。
en: I {dropped::drop} my phone in the car park yesterday.

zh: 我朋友上周借给我五十块钱。
en: My friend {lent::lend} me fifty dollars last week.

zh: 昨天下班后我们聊了一个小时。
en: We {chatted::chat} for an hour after work yesterday.

zh: 我昨天本来打算给你打电话，但是忘了。
en: I {meant::mean} to call you yesterday, but it slipped my mind.

zh: 我昨天一整天都在担心面试的事。
en: I {worried::worry} about the interview all day yesterday.

zh: 今天早上六点我的手机响了。
en: My phone {rang::ring} at six this morning.

zh: 她今天早上把文件复制到了U盘里。
en: She {copied::copy} the files to a USB drive this morning.

zh: 那艘船去年在暴风雨中沉没了。
en: The boat {sank::sink} in a storm last year.

zh: 他昨天没付停车费。
en: He {didn't pay|did not pay::not pay} for parking yesterday.

zh: 他上个月申请了三份工作。
en: He {applied::apply} for three jobs last month.

zh: 昨天面试前，他和每个人都握了手。
en: He {shook::shake} hands with everyone before the interview yesterday.

zh: 昨天我们匆匆赶到登机口，刚好赶上飞机。
en: Yesterday we {hurried::hurry} to the gate and just made the flight.

zh: 上周有人在健身房偷了我的钱包。
en: Someone {stole::steal} my wallet at the gym last week.

zh: 我今天早上上班前把洗碗机清空了。
en: I {emptied::empty} the dishwasher before work this morning.

zh: 他昨晚发誓说他再也不迟到了。
en: Last night he {swore::swear} he would never be late again.

zh: 昨天的会议几点结束的？
en: What time did the meeting {finish::finish} yesterday?

zh: 他在昨天的会议上承认了自己的错误。
en: He {admitted::admit} his mistake in the meeting yesterday.

zh: 我昨天踢足球时把短裤撕破了。
en: I {tore::tear} my shorts playing football yesterday.

zh: 昨晚吃了第二个汉堡，我很后悔。
en: I {regretted::regret} eating that second burger last night.

zh: 我们昨天中午吃了寿司。
en: We {ate::eat} sushi for lunch yesterday.

zh: 我上周五提交了工时表。
en: I {submitted::submit} my timesheet last Friday.

zh: 他昨晚喝了太多咖啡，结果睡不着。
en: He {drank::drink} too much coffee last night and couldn't sleep.

zh: 昨天开车回来的路上，我们没有停下来吃午饭。
en: We {didn't stop|did not stop::not stop} for lunch on the drive home yesterday.

zh: 我今天早上上班路上顺便买了杯咖啡。
en: I {grabbed::grab} a coffee on the way to work this morning.

zh: 我今天早上坐火车去上班。
en: I {took::take} the train to work this morning.

zh: 我昨晚把钱转到你的账户上了。
en: I {transferred::transfer} the money to your account last night.

zh: 经理昨天给我们放了一天假。
en: Our manager {gave::give} us a day off yesterday.

zh: 昨天屏幕突然变黑的时候，我慌了。
en: I {panicked::panic} when the screen suddenly went black yesterday.

zh: 我昨天在抽屉里找到了钥匙。
en: I {found::find} my keys in the drawer yesterday.

zh: 你昨天在商场买了什么？
en: What {did you buy::you, buy} at the mall yesterday?

zh: 我们昨天下班后打了网球。
en: We {played::play} tennis after work yesterday.

zh: 她上周在机场丢了护照。
en: She {lost::lose} her passport at the airport last week.

zh: 上周末我们住在海边的一家旅馆。
en: We {stayed::stay} at a hotel near the beach last weekend.

zh: 他昨天五点就下班了。
en: He {left::leave} work at five yesterday.

zh: 我上周日去看望了爷爷奶奶。
en: I {visited::visit} my grandparents last Sunday.

zh: 昨天跑完步后，我感觉好多了。
en: I {felt::feel} much better after my run yesterday.

zh: 她上周为什么选了那个供应商？
en: Why {did she choose::she, choose} that supplier last week?

zh: 昨天的会议上发生了什么？
en: What {happened::happen} at the meeting yesterday?

zh: 昨天开会时他一直在看手机。
en: He {kept::keep} checking his phone during the meeting yesterday.

zh: 他们上周五给了我这份工作。
en: They {offered::offer} me the job last Friday.

zh: 我昨晚只睡了四个小时。
en: I only {slept::sleep} four hours last night.

zh: 我昨晚没有为考试复习。
en: I {didn't study|did not study::not study} for the test last night.

zh: 我们团队在2022年开发了这个应用。
en: Our team {developed::develop} this app in 2022.

zh: 我们两年前在一次会议上认识的。
en: We {met::meet} at a conference two years ago.

zh: 我昨天在湿地板上滑了一下。
en: I {slipped::slip} on the wet floor yesterday.

zh: 洗碗机上周五又坏了。
en: The dishwasher {broke::break} down again last Friday.

zh: 备份昨晚没有运行。
en: The backup {didn't run|did not run::not run} last night.

zh: 我上周末整理了车库。
en: I {tidied::tidy} the garage last weekend.

zh: 我昨天忘了备份数据库。
en: I {forgot::forget} to back up the database yesterday.

zh: 我今天早上没吃早饭就出门了。
en: I {skipped::skip} breakfast this morning.

zh: 她上周滑雪时摔倒了。
en: She {fell::fall} over while skiing last week.

zh: 他上周没有回复我的消息。
en: He {didn't reply|did not reply::not reply} to my message last week.

zh: 他们上周一把我的订单发出了。
en: They {shipped::ship} my order last Monday.

zh: 我们上个月飞去了皇后镇。
en: We {flew::fly} to Queenstown last month.

zh: 你今天早上吃药了吗？
en: {Did you take::you, take} your medicine this morning?

zh: 他们昨天一整晚都在为钱争吵。
en: They {argued::argue} about money all evening yesterday.

zh: 他昨天跑了十公里。
en: He {ran::run} ten kilometres yesterday.

zh: 我真的很喜欢昨晚的音乐会。
en: I really {enjoyed::enjoy} the concert last night.

zh: 他们去年把房子卖了。
en: They {sold::sell} their house last year.

zh: 昨天这节课是谁教的？
en: Who {taught::teach} the class yesterday?

zh: 他昨天十分钟就修好了那个漏洞。
en: He {fixed::fix} the bug in ten minutes yesterday.

zh: 上周六我们在海里游了泳。
en: We {swam::swim} in the sea last Saturday.

zh: 去年的机票花了多少钱？
en: How much {did the flights cost::the flights, cost} last year?

zh: 我们2020年搬到了惠灵顿。
en: We {moved::move} to Wellington in 2020.

zh: 她在昨天的会议上讲了二十分钟。
en: She {spoke::speak} for twenty minutes at yesterday's meeting.

zh: 我们昨天没赶上渡轮。
en: We {didn't catch|did not catch::not catch} the ferry yesterday.

zh: 宝宝昨晚哭了一整夜。
en: The baby {cried::cry} all night last night.

zh: 我今天早上五点就醒了。
en: I {woke::wake} up at five this morning.

zh: 你昨晚睡得好吗？
en: {Did you sleep::you, sleep} well last night?

zh: 我们队上周六赢了比赛。
en: Our team {won::win} the game last Saturday.
